# Tomanit Merchant API

> Machine-readable API documentation for AI agents and developers.

## Primary OpenAPI (JSON)

- Live (recommended): https://api.tunne.lol/merchant/v1/openapi.json
- Static mirror: /openapi/merchant-api.json

## Human docs

- https://tomanit.tunne.lol/docs/merchant-api

## Auth

Authorization: Bearer TomanIt:{shopId}:{token}

## Endpoints

- POST /merchant/v1/invoices — create invoice
- GET /merchant/v1/invoices/{ref} — invoice status (payToken or INV-code)

## Callbacks

HTTPS POST to merchant callbackUrl with events: invoice.paid | invoice.failed
